en.title: Global Policy Shifts and New Tools Boost Disability Accessibility
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development issued new guidance that narrows fair‑housing claims related to building accessibility, potentially weakening enforcement of disability access standards. Meanwhile, the European Union adopted updated digital accessibility standards, and Taiwan’s Hua Nan Bank received certification for its visually‑impaired‑friendly e‑指沖 app. Additional developments include a UN committee report on CRPD implementation and ongoing advocacy for inclusive policies.

zh-TW.title: 全球政策變革與新工具提升殘障無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 美國住房與城市發展部發布指引，限制針對建築無障礙問題的公平住房索賠，可能削弱對殘障人士的住房無障礙要求。歐盟同步更新數位無障礙標準，華南銀行的視障友善「e指沖」App亦獲得無障礙認證。其他消息包括X平台上關於無障礙設計的討論以及2026年國際殘疾人日獎項提名開啟。
